title: Artifact
description: TOGAF-sourced archetype — a granular architecture work product (catalog, matrix, or diagram) that composes a Deliverable. Artifacts are the atomic documentation units of TOGAF's ADM. Placed in unclassified/ for GSM placement deliberation: may be a description-plane evidence object (observability artifact), a definition-plane output, or a governance record. TOGAF mapping: Artifact (ADM Content Metamodel, Architecture Governance). Source framework: TOGAF (ADM, Content Framework).

artifactType.description: TOGAF artifact classification. CATALOG = structured list (e.g., Technology Standards Catalog). MATRIX = relationship mapping (e.g., Application/Data Matrix). DIAGRAM = visual representation (e.g., Application Communication Diagram). TOGAF mapping: Artifact type taxonomy.

admPhase.description: ADM phase that produces this artifact. TOGAF mapping: ADM phase.

scope.description: Architecture domain or subject area this artifact covers. TOGAF mapping: Artifact scope.
